state.objective: Design detailed process ownership, posting roles and end-to-end accounting flows for a centralized retail PT Perorangan. Distinguish business initiator, process owner, system poster, reviewer, approver, reconciler and manual-journal authority.

organization.operating_sites: HO and multiple retail units are sites in one PT Perorangan.
organization.finance_model: Finance and all bank access are centralized at HO.
organization.unit_limits: Units handle physical sales cash, petty cash, cashier float, stock receipt/count and operational documents. Units cannot access or operate bank accounts and cannot transact directly with other units.
organization.coa_model: 225 working natural accounts with governed dimensions; user forms should capture business events rather than expose the full COA.
organization.route_model: HO-unit only. Origin/destination belong on shipment or transfer documents, not a general counter_site journal dimension.

control_principles: Business departments own source data and operational approval within their mandate.
Accounting postings should be generated from approved source documents where possible.
Manual journals are exceptional, reason-coded, supported, reviewed and restricted.
The same user should not initiate, approve, pay and reconcile the same transaction.
Process owner is not automatically the journal poster or final approver.

posting_architecture.instructions: What should be the default posting architecture?

criteria.subledger: Approved business documents create system postings through configured rules; manual journals are exceptions.
criteria.manual: Every department manually chooses debit and credit accounts.
criteria.finance_rekey: Finance rekeys every approved operational event into journals.

process_owner_vs_poster.instructions: Should process ownership and journal-posting authority be separate concepts?

criteria.yes: Owner defines and approves business substance; system/accounting layer posts according to rules.
criteria.no: The process owner should always post journals manually.

manual_journal_owner.instructions: Who should own unrestricted manual-journal capability?

criteria.accounting_restricted: Only authorized HO General Accounting roles, with approval based on amount/risk and audit trail.

sales_owner.instructions: Who should own the end-to-end sales transaction process and commercial terms?

criteria.commercial: Commercial owns product/pricing/promotion/channel rules; Operations owns store execution.
criteria.finance: Finance owns pricing and store execution.

sales_source.instructions: What should create the accounting entry for completed retail sales?

criteria.pos: POS/e-commerce order and tender settlement data create system posting.
criteria.cashier_journal: Cashier manually selects revenue and cash accounts.

store_execution_owner.instructions: Who should own cashier shift, store opening/closing and physical sales-cash handoff?

criteria.operations: Operations/Unit Manager owns execution and evidence; Finance defines cash controls and reconciles.
criteria.treasury: HO Treasury physically runs every store shift.

cash_deposit_owner.instructions: Who should initiate and who should complete a unit sales-cash deposit?

criteria.unit_then_treasury: Unit records counted cash and handoff; HO Treasury controls bank deposit/confirmation and reconciliation is independent.

petty_cash_owner.instructions: Who should own petty-cash business use and accounting control?

criteria.split: Requesting department/Operations owns purpose; Unit Custodian holds cash; GA or relevant owner verifies evidence; Finance defines limits, replenishes and reconciles.
criteria.custodian_all: Custodian requests, approves, pays and reconciles.

criteria.requester: The benefiting department such as HR, GA, Operations, Commercial or Inventory raises a requisition with budget/cost center.
criteria.ap: Accounts Payable invents all purchase needs.

vendor_and_po_owner.instructions: Who should own vendor selection and purchase-order approval?

criteria.procurement_or_ga_control: A procurement function, or GA where procurement sits, controls vendor/PO with requester and budget-owner approval; AP remains independent.
criteria.ap: AP selects vendor and approves its own payment.
criteria.unit_cashier: Unit cashier creates supplier masters and POs.

goods_receipt_owner.instructions: Who should own receipt of merchandise inventory?

criteria.inventory: Unit/HO Inventory records physical receipt against PO/shipment; requester or warehouse validates quantity/condition.

service_receipt_owner.instructions: Who confirms receipt of non-inventory goods or services?

criteria.requester: Benefiting process owner such as HR/GA/Operations/Commercial confirms delivery or service completion.

invoice_owner.instructions: Who should validate and record supplier invoices?

criteria.ap: HO AP performs invoice validation and matching after independent receipt evidence.

payment_owner.instructions: Who should prepare, approve and release supplier payments?

criteria.segregated: AP prepares approved due items; Finance Manager/authorized approver approves; Treasury releases payment; independent accounting/reconciliation reviews.
criteria.ap_all: AP prepares, approves, releases and reconciles.

inventory_transfer_owner.instructions: Who owns HO-to-unit inventory transfer execution and accounting evidence?

criteria.inventory: Inventory owns transfer order, dispatch, shipment and receipt; Operations/Unit confirms receipt; system posts transit movements.
criteria.finance: Finance manually records quantities without shipment documents.

stock_count_owner.instructions: Who should own stock-count execution and variance approval?

criteria.split: Inventory/Operations execute and count; independent reviewer approves variance; Finance evaluates accounting/allowance impact.
criteria.counter_all: The same counter approves and posts variance.
criteria.finance_count: Finance performs every physical count alone.

hr_master_owner.instructions: Who owns employee master, employment events and payroll inputs?

criteria.hr: HR owns authorized employee/master and attendance/benefit inputs; payroll calculation and posting controls remain segregated.
criteria.finance: Finance changes employee terms without HR authorization.

payroll_flow_owner.instructions: What is the appropriate payroll ownership split?

criteria.split: HR validates employee/input data; HO Payroll calculates; HR Manager reviews people data; Finance reviews funding/accounting; Treasury pays; GL posting is system-generated.
criteria.hr_all: HR calculates, approves, pays and reconciles.
criteria.treasury_all: Treasury sets employee data and payroll.

ga_owner.instructions: Which processes should GA primarily own?

criteria.facilities: Facilities, utilities, office supplies, permits, general services, maintenance requests, leases administration and related service evidence, with Finance accounting review.

asset_owner.instructions: How should fixed-asset ownership be divided?

criteria.split: Business/GA initiates acquisition and custody; Inventory/asset custodian tags and locates; Asset Accounting controls capitalization, depreciation and disposal accounting; approver authorizes disposal.

tax_owner.instructions: Who should own tax determination, filing and tax-account reconciliation?

criteria.tax: HO Tax owns tax codes/returns; source departments provide evidence; Accounting/AP/AR post through configured rules; Finance Manager reviews.

commercial_settlement.instructions: Who owns marketplace/acquirer commercial agreements versus cash settlement reconciliation?

criteria.split: Commercial owns contracts, fees and channel terms; AR/Treasury reconciles settlement and cash; Accounting reviews revenue presentation.
criteria.commercial_all: Commercial approves and reconciles its own cash receipts.
criteria.treasury_terms: Treasury sets selling prices and contracts.

bank_master_owner.instructions: Who should create and approve bank-account master records?

criteria.treasury_dual: HO Treasury initiates; Finance Manager/Director independently approves; access administration is controlled and audited.
criteria.single_user: One Treasury user creates and approves.

criteria.accounting: HO General Accounting coordinates close; subledger owners certify; Finance Manager approves; system derives current profit and closes retained earnings.
criteria.units: Each unit closes separate company books.

audit_role.instructions: What access should auditor roles have?

criteria.readonly: Read-only access to transactions, evidence, approvals, mappings and logs; no posting or approval in audited flows.

owner_director_role.instructions: What should the PT Perorangan owner/director do in routine flows?

criteria.high_risk_approval: Approve policy, bank master, high-value/related-party/exception transactions and major write-offs; avoid routine data entry and reconciliation.
